Method of Attack: Steals saved login credentials from browsers, FTP, mail, and terminal programs and sends them to command and control server; downloads and installs ransomware
Encrypts victim's files appending .zemblax extension; periodically deletes files until ransom is paid
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with weaponized Excel spreadsheet attachments exploiting CVE-2017-11882 Microsoft Office Equation Editor remote code execution vulnerability
Downloaded and executed malware from remote site after exploitation
Indicators of Compromise: Weaponized Excel attachments named Swift.xlsx, orders.xlsx, Invoice For Payment.xlsx, Inquiry.xlsx
